knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(kableExtra)
```



# Gene Expression Omnibus

<br>

```{r echo=FALSE}
geodatasets <- read.csv("data/geo_datasets.csv",header=TRUE,sep=";")
addGeoLink <- function(x){
  paste("[",x,"](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=",x,")",sep="")
}
geodatasets$Accession <- addGeoLink(geodatasets$Accession)
```



```{r results='asis',echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(geodatasets[,c("Title","Type","Accession","Sample")], "html") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = TRUE)
```

<br>
<br>
